### When God Seems Absent
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-sept-2-2008-11581174.html
Passage: Esther 6:12-14
Points:
- Although believers often crave swift justice against wicked behavior, God never overlooks arrogant motives or evil schemes.
- God's apparent silence does not mean He is passive, out of touch, or unfaithful to His promises.
- Human pride unravels rapidly under the weight of God's sovereign providence.
- Even when circumstances make God seem absent, He is fully present and drawing us to rely on Him.
